source.chapter: Algorithm DC-Tree for k-Servers on Trees
source.author: Marek Chrobak
source.scope: Path-tree restriction of DC-Tree simultaneous equal-speed movement; no competitive-ratio measurement.

contract.operation: For every request, move all active servers toward it at unit speed until the first active server reaches it; lowest server index is active among servers sharing a location.
contract.movement_cost: Sum of the distances traveled by active servers for that request.
contract.output_layout: For each request: [movement_cost,all server positions in index order], signed 64-bit little-endian.
contract.error_precedence: Malformed or out-of-range input returns -1 before output checks; null output or insufficient byte capacity returns -2 without writes.

workspace.meaning: At most four server positions and twelve staged request records.
